scope: TWII same-day cash open versus prior TWII cash close only
data_semantics: FinMind TaiwanFuturesDaily after_market date D covers prior business day 15:00 through D 05:00; signal_date equals D.
algorithm: Prediction is sign(tx_night_spread_per). On each run, select an absolute confidence threshold from quantiles 0.00 through 0.90 step 0.05 using only the latest 756 completed aligned days; require at least 10% training coverage; apply the frozen threshold to subsequent dates.
warning: Validated only for the opening-gap direction. Do not interpret it as the cash-close, multi-day, or macro-cycle direction.
